name: Sia Pickersgill
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Sia is a registered clinical counsellor and psychotherapist with experience working with teens, adults, and couples. Sia's special interests are: ~ Trauma and PTSD ~ Anxiety, depression and anger ~ Self-harm and suicidal ideation ~ Mens Work ~ Domestic violence and sexual abuse ~ Social, behavioural and emotional issues ~ Addictive behaviours ~ Emotion/Parent Coaching ~ Couples Counselling ~ Child + Adolescent counselling Sia provides a caring, supportive, and non-judgemental environment, and believes seeking help is not a sign of weakness but a sign of strength, wisdom, and a step toward self-awareness — a process that often leads to happier, healthier lives. Sia's treatment approach is integrative, focusing on finding the right fit for each client by drawing on evidence-based methods, including Trauma-Informed Counselling, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, Psychodynamic Psychotherapy, Solution-Focused Therapy, Compassionate Inquiry, and Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT). She also incorporates EMDR, Internal Family Systems (IFS) and Somatic Therapies when appropriate.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Ryan Klibansky
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a qualified counsellor and psychotherapist who provides a warm, supportive and non-judgemental space for people to explore what is happening in their lives and better understand themselves. My approach is collaborative and tailored to each person, drawing on a range of therapeutic approaches depending on your needs, goals and circumstances. I work with adults and young people experiencing challenges such as anxiety, low mood, stress, relationship difficulties, life transitions, self-esteem concerns and feeling stuck or overwhelmed.

name: Maria Lazovic
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Welcome to the unique world of Soul Centred Psychotherapy - a transformative journey which unfolds in a safe and supportive space with empathy, grace, dignity and most importantly, in the context of a genuine human relationship with your therapist. In a time when individuals often feel reduced to a diagnosis, a holistic approach offers a different path. Maria’s personal areas of interest are: Death & Grief, Life Transitions, Life Purpose, Relationship Challenges, Trauma Healing, Confidence Development, Speech/Voice Issues, Executive/Business well-being.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy
